As long as the cube is red in every kitchen, the rule “reach for red” works in the data however the tablecloth and the light change, and the model doesn't learn the shape. Different objects break this rule, and the tablecloths and the light add robustness to the background and the lighting on top of that. Diversity helps along the axis on which the test world changes, which is why DROID counts scenes, objects, tasks and viewpoints separately.
